# Code of Conduct

**Ranzlappen Repo Standards** adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/) as its code of conduct. The canonical text is maintained at that URL; maintainers agree to enforce it as written.

This repo is the source of the templates that other Ranzlappen repos adopt — the Code of Conduct that ships in every downstream `templates/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` is the same one that governs contributions here.

## Reporting

Concerns may be reported privately via either of these channels:

1. **GitHub private vulnerability reporting** (preferred for security-adjacent reports): [open a draft advisory](../../security/advisories/new).
2. **Direct message to the repo owner** ([`@Ranzlappen`](https://github.com/Ranzlappen)) for everything else.

Reports are read by the project maintainers and treated confidentially. Acknowledgement target: 3 business days. Triage decision target: 10 business days. The same SLAs as [`SECURITY.md`](./SECURITY.md), since the routes overlap.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may, at their discretion, hide comments, lock threads, close PRs or issues, or report contributors to GitHub Trust & Safety for violations of this code, the [GitHub Community Guidelines](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/github-terms/github-community-guidelines), or the [GitHub Acceptable Use Policies](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/acceptable-use-policies/github-acceptable-use-policies).

Enforcement actions are recorded in the relevant thread for transparency unless redaction is necessary to protect a reporter.
